lead.en: SSC has not published the 2026 notification for the Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination, 2026 (checked 7 Nov 2026), and it is not in SSC's 2026 calendar. Everything below is from the 2025 notice and is shown as tentative reference, not as a 2026 rule.
lead.hi: SSC ने दिल्ली पुलिस में प्रधान सिपाही (लिपिकीय) परीक्षा, 2026 की की 2026 की अधिसूचना जारी नहीं की है (7 नवंबर 2026 को जाँचा) और यह SSC के 2026 कैलेंडर में भी नहीं है। नीचे सब कुछ 2025 की सूचना से है और अस्थायी संदर्भ के रूप में दिखाया गया है, 2026 के नियम के रूप में नहीं।

title.hi: SSC नोटिस बोर्ड (7 नवंबर 2026 को जाँचा)
हेड कांस्टेबल (मिनिस्ट्रियल) 2025 की संशोधित रिक्तियाँ (25 फरवरी 2026)
स्किल और कंप्यूटर टेस्ट, 2025 की सूचना

facts.value: NO. As of 07.11.2026 there is no Notice of Examination for a 2026 Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police examination on ssc.gov.in.

NO. Neither examination appears in the SSC examination calendar: the calendar API returns 13 records for 2026 and none of them is a Head Constable (Ministerial) or Head Constable (AWO/TPO) examination.
18 to 25 years as on 01.07.2025 (candidates born not before 02.07.2000 and not later than 01.07.2007).

SC/ST 5 years; OBC 3 years; PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years; PwBD (OBC) 13 years; PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years; Ex-Servicemen 3 years after deduction of military service rendered; sportspersons of distinction 5 years (10 years for SC/ST); Delhi Police departmental candidates up to 40 (UR/EWS), 43 (OBC) and 45 (SC/ST) years; widows/ divorced/ judicially separated women who have not re-married up to 35 (UR/EWS), 38 (OBC) and 40 (SC/ST) years.

10+2 (Senior Secondary) pass or equivalent from a recognised Board as on the closing date of the Online Application Form, plus professional attainments: 30 words per minute in English typing OR 25 words per minute in Hindi typing.

INR 100 (Rupees One Hundred only); women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD and eligible Ex-Servicemen are exempted; online payment only (BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa/ Mastercard/ Maestro/ RuPay debit cards); non-refundable and non-adjustable.

Four compulsory stages in order: (i) Computer Based Examination by SSC — 100 marks; (ii) PE&MT by the Delhi Police — qualifying; (iii) Typing Test on Computer by the Delhi Police — 25 marks; (iv) Computer (Formatting) Test by the Delhi Police — qualifying. Final merit is prepared on CBE (100 marks) + Typing Test (25 marks) + incentive/ bonus marks, if any. A 15% Reserve Panel is prepared category-wise and handed to the Delhi Police in a sealed cover.

label.hi: अर्हक अंक और शॉर्टलिस्टिंग (CBE) (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: Minimum qualifying marks in the CBE (normalised, without NCC bonus): UR/ EWS 40%; SC/ ST/ OBC 35%; PwBD/ Ex-Servicemen 30%; the Commission may lower them category-wise if enough candidates do not qualify. Candidates are called for PE&MT up to 20 times the number of vacancies in each category; PwBD candidates qualifying at 20 times their vacancies go directly to the Typing Test.

label.hi: बोनस अंक और टाई-ब्रेक (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: NCC 'C' 5%, 'B' 3%, 'A' 2% of the maximum marks (not for Ex-servicemen); Rashtriya Raksha University degree/ PG diploma — Distinction 5%, First Class 4%, Second Class 3%, Pass Class 2%. Tie-break: older candidate → higher marks in the CBE → higher marks in the Typing Test on Computer → alphabetical order of first names.

Male: height 165 cm, chest 78–82 cm with a minimum 4 cm expansion. Female: height 157 cm. Height/ chest relaxable by 5 cm for residents of hill areas (Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas, Dogras, Marathas and candidates belonging to Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya, Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Kashmir region of J&K and Ladakh), for ST candidates (height and chest, male) and SC/ST candidates (height, female), and for sons/ daughters of serving, retired or deceased Delhi Police personnel/ Multi-Tasking Staff.

label.en: Disability exemption and medical standard (2025 notice)
label.hi: दिव्यांग छूट और चिकित्सा मानक (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: PwBD candidates (locomotor disability 40% and above — OL or BL) are exempted from PE&MT but must appear for Document Verification. Medical standard: sound health, free from defect, deformity or disease, and a vision of 6/12 with or without glasses in both eyes; no relaxation for any category. For PwBD the physical requirements are F, PP, L, B, S and BL.

label.hi: कंप्यूटर पर टाइपिंग टेस्ट (2025 की सूचना)

facts.value: For candidates who qualify PE&MT and for PwBD candidates who qualify the CBE. 10 minutes' duration, carrying a maximum of 25 marks which count towards the final result. Passage of at least 400 words/ 2000 strokes in English or 350 words/ 1750 strokes in Hindi. Minimum qualifying speed 30 w.p.m. English or 25 w.p.m. Hindi. Marking: 30 w.p.m. = 10 marks; 31–35 = 12; 36–40 = 15; 41–45 = 18; 46–50 = 21; above 50 = 25 (Hindi bands are 5 w.p.m. lower throughout: 25 = 10 marks … above 45 = 25 marks); below the minimum speed disqualifies; 1 word is deducted for each mistake.

Qualifying test for candidates who qualify the Typing Test, on MS-Word, MS-PowerPoint and MS-Excel; 10 minutes for each test. 20 formatting features are tested in each test at half a mark each (10 marks per test); at least 6 marks in each test are required to qualify. Editing tools may be used to correct mistakes.

note.en: 2025 vacancies, not 2026 figures. SSC publishes the vacancies as reported by Delhi Police.
note.hi: 2025 की रिक्तियाँ, 2026 के आँकड़े नहीं। SSC रिक्तियाँ वैसे ही छापता है जैसी दिल्ली पुलिस बताती है।

note.en: Only candidates who qualify the race attempt the long jump, then the high jump.
note.hi: केवल दौड़ में सफल उम्मीदवार लंबी कूद और फिर ऊँची कूद देते हैं।

section.en: Part B: Quantitative Aptitude (Basic Arithmetic Skill)
section.hi: भाग B: मात्रात्मक योग्यता (बुनियादी अंकगणित कौशल)

section.en: Part E: Computer Fundamentals, MS Excel, MS Word, Communication, Internet, WWW and Web Browsers, etc.
section.hi: भाग E: कंप्यूटर की बुनियादी बातें, MS Excel, MS Word, संचार, इंटरनेट, WWW और वेब ब्राउज़र आदि

notes.en: One objective multiple-choice paper. 0.25 mark is cut for each wrong answer.
notes.hi: एक वस्तुनिष्ठ बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्नपत्र। हर गलत उत्तर पर 0.25 अंक कटेगा।

notes.en: In Hindi and English only. No scribe is provided to PwBD candidates.
notes.hi: केवल हिंदी और अंग्रेज़ी में। दिव्यांग उम्मीदवारों को स्क्राइब नहीं मिलता।

notes.en: Scores from several shifts are normalised as per SSC's notice of 2 June 2025.
notes.hi: कई शिफ्टों के अंक SSC की 2 जून 2025 की सूचना के अनुसार नॉर्मलाइज़ होते हैं।

notes.en: This is the 2025 pattern. SSC has not published the 2026 notice.
notes.hi: यह 2025 का पैटर्न है। SSC ने 2026 की सूचना जारी नहीं की है।
